en.answer:
If the same player controls multiple <<6821>> and a Monster Effect, or a Spell/Trap Card is activated, the effects of all <<6821>> are chained to that activation in any order decided by their controller. Then the Chain is resolved normally in the reversed order.
In that case, the effect of <<6821>> that was activated as Chain Link 3 was not directly chained to the effect of Chain Link 1 that caused the activation of its effect, so the effect of that <<6821>> will not be applied and it will not lose 500 ATK.
Additionally, since the effect of each <<6821>> can only be activated once per Chain, the effects of <<6821>> will not further be activated in that Chain.
en.question: What happens if a Monster Effect, or a Spell/Trap Card is activated while multiple <<6821>> are on the field?
en.title: What happens if a Trap Card is activated while multiple <<6821>> are on the field?

ja.answer:
複数体の「<<6821>>」を同一のプレイヤーがコントロールしている時に、モンスター効果や罠カード等が発動した場合、プレイヤーの任意の順番で「<<6821>>」の効果をチェーンに乗せて、逆順処理を行います。
その場合、チェーン3の「<<6821>>」の効果は、発動のきっかけとなったチェーン1の効果に直接チェーンしていない為、効果は適用されず、攻撃力は下がりません。
なお、「<<6821>>」の効果は同一チェーン上で複数回発動しない為、更に「<<6821>>」の効果はチェーンされません。
